pages.text: $(italic)A celestial being cast from grace. Frail but devastatingly lethal.$()$(br2)$(bold)Racial Traits:$()$(br2)$(bold)Lethal Grace$() — $(item)+15% damage from all sources$(). The highest racial damage bonus.$(br2)$(bold)Bloodthirst$() — $(item)Permanent Strength I$(). Your fallen nature demands violence.$(br2)$(bold)Dark Expulsion$() — $(item)Launch yourself forward$(), leaving a withering cloud. 25-second cooldown.$(br2)$(bold)Wither Shot$() — $(item)Fire a wither skull projectile$(). 3-second cooldown.$(br2)$(bold)Tattered Wings$() — $(item)Slow fall$(). Not true flight.

pages.title: Fallen Weaknesses
pages.text: $(bold)Broken Body$() — $(warn)-20% max HP (4 fewer hearts)$(). Your mortal frame is frail.$(br2)$(bold)Carnivorous Hunger$() — $(warn)Non-meat foods provide 50% less nourishment.$(br2)$(bold)Fire Vulnerability$() — $(warn)Fire burns deeper against your fallen form.$(br2)$(bold)Dark Resilience$() — $(item)Immune to Wither, Poison, Instant Damage, and Nausea.$(br2)$(bold)Claustrophobia$() — $(warn)Slower under roofs$(). The memory of confinement haunts you.
